name: sensei_warden_full_policy
description: Warden with 5 policies including after clauses and max_retries parses successfully
input:
agent forge_sensei
  on start
    say "ready"

agent specialist
  on start
    say "ready"

warden sensei_warden
  manages [forge_sensei, specialist]
  on stuck: nudge, self
    after 3: escalate
  on hallucination: restart, self
  on crash: restart, self
  on timeout: restart, self
  on budget: nudge, self
    after 1: escalate
  max_retries 3 per 1h then escalate
